name: Mitten Extracts Disposable | Frosted Ice
description: Cool, refreshing, and smooth from the first pull, Frosted Ice delivers a winter-fresh flavor that hits like a deep breath of cold air. This limited-edition 2g disposable blends crisp mint notes with a subtle sweetness, creating a clean, invigorating profile perfect for daytime focus or nighttime wind-downs. Frosted Ice is built for anyone who wants flavor that feels fresh, bright, and downright chill.
